command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin omega-vps-deploy
git checkout omega-vps-deploy
git reset --hard origin/omega-vps-deploy
OVER=/workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo/omega_deploy/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1
BASE=$(readlink -f /workspace/omega_runtime/current)
DST=/workspace/omega_runtime/releases/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1-candidate-003
test -d "$BASE"
test -d "$OVER"
test ! -e "$DST"
mkdir -p "$DST"
cp -a "$BASE"/. "$DST"/
for f in config/assembly.json omega/assembly.py omega/__init__.py omega/cortex.py omega/retina_coupling.py omega/grid_runtime_v3.py omega/supervisor.py omega/supervisor_outer.py omega/intake.py omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py; do
  test -f "$OVER/$f"
  mkdir -p "$DST/$(dirname "$f")"
  cp "$OVER/$f" "$DST/$f"
done
python3 -m compileall -q "$DST/omega"
PYTHONPATH="$DST" OMEGA_MASTER_COGNITION_INTERVAL=999999 python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from omega.assembly import AssemblyManifest, load_source_registry
from omega.cortex import CortexCore, CortexEvent
from omega.grid_runtime_v3 import Runtime
from omega.retina_coupling import RetinaCapture, RetinaCortexBridge
from omega.supervisor import Supervisor as S1
from omega.supervisor_outer import Supervisor as S2
root=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/releases/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1-candidate-003')
for mod in ('omega.alignment','omega.unified_store','omega.spool_receipt_reconciler','omega.cortex','omega.retina_coupling'):
    assert importlib.util.find_spec(mod) is not None, mod
manifest=AssemblyManifest.from_path(root/'config'/'assembly.json')
_, sources=load_source_registry(root/'config'/'sources.json')
manifest.validate(sources)
assert S1 is S2
assert ('omega.retina','omega.cortex') in manifest.connections
assert ('omega.cortex','omega.retina') in manifest.connections
assert len([x for x in manifest.organs if x.organ_id=='omega.grid']) == 1
assert len([x for x in manifest.organs if x.organ_id=='omega.cortex']) == 1
bridge=RetinaCortexBridge()
cap=RetinaCapture('cap-smoke','a'*64,'cause-smoke',1,'smoke-source')
event=bridge.project_result(cap, {'description':'OMEGA screen','ocr':['OMEGA'],'face_count':0}, attention_context={'attention_priority':0.85,'unresolved_visual_questions':['what changed?'],'text_salient':True})
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='omega-sigma-smoke-') as td:
    td=Path(td); state=td/'state'; db=td/'omega.db'
    rt=Runtime(state,0.01,root/'config'/'organ_router.json',db,root)
    packet={'schema':'OMEGA_CORTEX_EVENT/v1','event_id':event.event_id,'kind':event.kind,'causal_id':event.causal_id,'meta_order':event.meta_order,'evidence_class':event.evidence_class,'source':event.source,'payload':dict(event.payload),'provenance':dict(event.provenance)}
    (state/'cortex_inbox'/'retina.json').write_text(json.dumps(packet),encoding='utf-8')
    epoch=rt.start_epoch(); rt.frame(epoch,'VPS_RETINA_CORTEX_SMOKE')
    status=json.loads((state/'STATUS.json').read_text())
    assert status['selected']['cell_id']=='CORTEX', status
    assert status['result']['effect_authority'] is False
    assert status['result']['cortex']['evidence_class']=='VERIFIED_DERIVED'
    assert status['cortex']['feedback_files'] >= 1
    assert (state/'cortex_state'/'STATE.json').exists()
    assert not (state/'cortex_runtime.sqlite3').exists()
# Explicit evidence-monotonicity falsifier: UNKNOWN visual input must remain UNKNOWN.
unknown=CortexEvent(event_id='u1',kind='retina.observation',causal_id='cu1',meta_order=2,evidence_class='UNKNOWN',source='unbound-retina',payload={'raw_capture_hash':'f'*64,'description':'maybe','ocr':['OMEGA'],'face_count':1,'attention_priority':0.9},provenance={})
p=CortexCore().ingest(unknown)
assert {a.evidence_class for a in p.state_atoms} == {'UNKNOWN'}
assert p.grid_proposals[0]['evidence_class'] == 'UNKNOWN'
print(json.dumps({'pass':True,'tests':['full_live_base','compileall','manifest_validate','single_grid','supervisor_alias','receipt_reconciler_present','retina_to_cortex_to_grid','unknown_stays_unknown','no_effect_authority','feedback_emitted','no_second_cortex_db']},sort_keys=True))
PY
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
PYTHONPATH="$DST" python3 -m omega.assembly --repo-root "$DST" --runtime-root "$TMP/state" --db "$TMP/omega.db" --once > "$TMP/assembly.json"
python3 - <<PY
import json, pathlib
x=json.loads(pathlib.Path('$TMP/assembly.json').read_text()); assert x.get('schema')=='OMEGA_ASSEMBLY_STATUS/v1'; assert x.get('static_core_bound') is True, x; print(json.dumps({'assembly_static_core_bound':True,'status':x.get('status')},sort_keys=True))
PY
printf 'BASE=%s\nCANDIDATE=%s\nCURRENT=%s\n' "$BASE" "$DST" "$(readlink -f /workspace/omega_runtime/current)"
